body:
The following code:

``` js
var o = {
    f(c = 2) {}
};
```

breaks ESLint 1.5.1 (i.e. the latest one) completely:

```
/Users/mgol/Documents/projects/bn/cbn/repo/polona-gui/node_modules/estraverse/estraverse.js:517
                        throw new Error('Unknown node type ' + nodeType + '.');
                        ^

Error: Unknown node type AssignmentPattern.
    at Controller.traverse (/Users/mgol/Documents/projects/bn/cbn/repo/polona-gui/node_modules/estraverse/estraverse.js:517:31)
    at EventEmitter.module.exports.api.verify (/Users/mgol/Documents/projects/bn/cbn/repo/polona-gui/node_modules/eslint/lib/eslint.js:780:24)
    at processText (/Users/mgol/Documents/projects/bn/cbn/repo/polona-gui/node_modules/eslint/lib/cli-engine.js:220:27)
    at processFile (/Users/mgol/Documents/projects/bn/cbn/repo/polona-gui/node_modules/eslint/lib/cli-engine.js:257:18)
    at executeOnFile (/Users/mgol/Documents/projects/bn/cbn/repo/polona-gui/node_modules/eslint/lib/cli-engine.js:600:23)
    at /Users/mgol/Documents/projects/bn/cbn/repo/polona-gui/node_modules/eslint/lib/cli-engine.js:624:17
    at Array.forEach (native)
    at CLIEngine.executeOnFiles (/Users/mgol/Documents/projects/bn/cbn/repo/polona-gui/node_modules/eslint/lib/cli-engine.js:622:18)
    at Object.cli.execute (/Users/mgol/Documents/projects/bn/cbn/repo/polona-gui/node_modules/eslint/lib/cli.js:159:95)
    at Object.<anonymous> (/Users/mgol/Documents/projects/bn/cbn/repo/polona-gui/node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js:61:20)
```

One issue is that this code is valid ES6 and should be recognized; another one is that a parse error should at least show which file cannot be parsed; it's very hard to find the reason when you have thousands of files and you just know one of them is causing this.
